review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 27 physical PDF pages, plus a numeric-token multiset comparison covering table cells; physical pages 6, 7, 10 and 26 were rendered to verify the three footnotes and reference [42]. The OCR contains no code fences and no swallowed blocks. The arXiv side stamp on page 1 and all page-1 teaser-table values live inside the embedded page-1 images, and Figure 3(B) time-axis labels (0.00-1.28 s) are figure-internal, so none are defects. The model-merging equation, Table 9 caption and tau-Voice passages are present as LaTeX-equivalent text. Table 10's General Text block prints en-dash placeholder cells and a fourth header column that the PDF itself leaves without a header label; the OCR records the dashes as hyphens and an empty cell, left unchanged.
